_comment: Phase 88.2 rollback config — restores live-update from app.untitledad.in. To use: copy this file's contents over capacitor.config.json, then run `npx cap sync android` + rebuild APK. Bundled mode (the default in capacitor.config.json after Phase 88.2) ships JS on-device for 5-10x faster app open at the cost of needing an APK rebuild per JS change.
